purpose: Own spawn point waves: authored wave config, trigger-started queue, the level-wide cap on living infected and where the wave appears.
state_owner: Which spawn points have fired this mission
Pending wave queue and the infected a wave spawned

spawn_wave_v1.configure_spawn: configure_spawn(config: Dictionary) -> void; spawn_config.gd keys enemy, count, interval, rule, batch, trigger; get_spawn_config() returns the repaired config
spawn_wave_v1.trigger_meta: wave_director.TRIGGER_META (spawn_triggers) on a placed infected lists the spawn point ids (planning_object_id) its death can start; each point fires once
spawn_wave_v1.cap: wave_director.max_alive (90) bounds living infected on the level; queued waves wait for a free slot and take turns
spawn_wave_v1.spawned: spawned infected are ordinary scenes added to the enemies root with set_target(player); meta spawned_by holds the point id
